memo:
A simple component for AI-generated pages.
Intended use: when you want to paste in a finished single HTML file created externally (e.g. by ChatGPT or another AI that doesn't know mikanBox's system) as-is and publish it directly. Since the pasted content is assumed to already be a complete file containing <html>/<head>/<body>, this component itself has no <html> tag etc. — it simply continues straight on from _global_head's output with the pasted content.

How to use: on the page editor screen, choose this "_ai" as the "Design Component," paste the finished HTML into the body field, check "Raw HTML," and save.

Note: if you're having an AI agent connected via MCP build the page directly, don't use this — use _layout (+ _header / _footer) instead and write the body in Markdown.
